## Summary

Karigaila, Jogaila's brother (not Kaributas), defends the Crooked Castle in 1390 and dies in its fall.

## Record vs saga

- **[Record]:** Died on 16 Sep 1390 when the Crooked Castle fell; Jogaila charged that the Knights beheaded him, the Order said he fell in the fighting; his head was carried on a stake round the Lower Castle (en.wikipedia, Siege of Vilnius 1390).
- **[Saga invention]:** In Book II ch. 7 he dies when the arch falls and his head is carried on a pole afterwards.
